prompts.text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: four full-body cardinal gaze anchors for an existing chibi dragon-girl pet, in one wide horizontal strip.
Reference roles: image 1 canonical-base is AUTHORITATIVE for the larger readable face, head/body proportions, lavender physical eyes, clean linework, pale white-lilac materials and every outfit feature. Image 2 grounded identity board preserves original identity and anatomical construction; its old tiny atlas is only historical context, do not shrink the new face. Image 3 completed standard contact sheet controls style and standing scale. Image 4 is an INVISIBLE four-slot spacing guide only: copy no guide pixels, borders, text or marks.
Exactly FOUR complete separated same-size full-body poses, equal-width slots, left to right: UP, SCREEN-RIGHT, DOWN, SCREEN-LEFT. Use a wide strip matching the guide, enough flat pure #00FF00 gutters that neighboring wing tips never touch. Complete horns, hair, ears, dress train, shoes, wings and attached tail inside each slot. Keep every foot on one shared horizontal baseline. No cropping, shadow or extras.
All four bodies face the viewer: same planted shoes, clasped waist hands, forward-facing torso and white/lilac dress, compact open wings and attached tail, exactly as the canonical base. ONLY the articulated neck, complete head, hair, horns, ears and physical eyes follow gaze. The head stays the same size. Do not rotate the entire character or make a body turntable.
POSE 1 UP: face broadly frontal, very clearly lift the chin toward the top edge, show the raised chin/under-jaw angle and visible lavender eyes aiming UP under raised eyelids. Keep the face visible and readable. This must unmistakably look above the viewer, not straight ahead.
POSE 2 SCREEN-RIGHT: neck and head yaw toward the image's RIGHT edge; nose tip, face surface and visible eye project RIGHT of head center. Body remains frontal. Silver temple rosette is on anatomical LEFT, therefore on the hidden FAR side during this turn: naturally occlude it behind the head, no rosette on the visible right-facing cheek.
POSE 3 DOWN: face broadly frontal, clearly tuck chin toward chest, lower gaze toward the bottom edge, fringe overlaps more forehead. Lavender irises are still visibly open and looking DOWN; not closed eyes, sleeping or neutral.
POSE 4 SCREEN-LEFT: neck and head yaw toward the image's LEFT edge; nose tip, face surface and eye project LEFT of head center. Body remains frontal. Anatomical LEFT temple rosette is on the visible NEAR side during this turn, attached naturally to that temple. Do not mirror or flip its anatomical attachment.
Preserve the canonical large chibi head, face and original eye construction with lavender irises, pupils, eyelids and highlights. No replacement eyes or pupil patches, inverted head, whole-sprite tilt/rotation, new props, labels, arrows, boxes, shadows, scenery, floating effects or green inside the pet. Background is absolutely flat pure #00FF00 everywhere outside the four characters.

Edit the FIRST reference, the existing four-gaze full-body strip. Keep the exact four character drawings, face directions, scale consistency, rosette anatomy, colors, dress, hands, wings, tail and linework. Change ONLY layout spacing: shrink ALL FOUR entire figures together by the same 20% factor and center one in each equal-width quarter of the image, feet on one common baseline, with a broad uninterrupted PURE #00FF00 vertical gutter on BOTH sides of each figure. Every wing tip must be comfortably at least 5% of a quarter-slot width away from its own quarter boundary; first and last poses also need outside margins. Four complete figures, no clipping, no touching between figures. Keep the 000 UP / 090 RIGHT / 180 DOWN / 270 LEFT exact existing left-to-right gaze order. No labels, arrows, boxes, guide marks, shadows or extras. Background only pure #00FF00.
Reference 1 is the edit target. Reference 2 canonical-base is authoritative for identity and the larger face, reference 3 grounded identity board is identity evidence, reference 4 completed standard contact sheet confirms design, reference 5 invisible four-slot layout guide shows the equal quarters only. Do not copy any guide or contact-sheet text/pixels. The character remains identical: only add generous space around each complete drawing.
